001package io.github.ai4ci.config;
002
003import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.ExportSelector;
004import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableContactDuckDB;
005import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableDebugParametersCSV;
006import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableInfectivityProfileCSV;
007import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableLineListDuckDB;
008import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableOutbreakBehaviourCountCSV;
009import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableOutbreakCSV;
010import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableOutbreakContactCountCSV;
011import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableOutbreakFinalStateCSV;
012import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableOutbreakHistoryCSV;
013import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutablePersonDemographicsDuckDB;
014import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutablePostVaccineCSV;
015import io.github.ai4ci.output.ImmutableViralChallengeCSV;
016
017/**
018 * Enumeration of the different exporters available in the system, each
019 * associated with an export selector.
020 *
021 * <p>
022 * This enum provides a convenient way to reference and manage the various
023 * exporters used for outputting different types of data during the simulation.
024 * Each exporter is linked to a specific CSV format and export stage, as defined
025 * by their respective selectors.
026 *
027 * @author Rob Challen
028 */
029public enum Exporters {
030
031        /**
032         * Exporter for outbreak summary data, using the ImmutableOutbreakCSV format.
033         */
034        SUMMARY(
035                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableOutbreakCSV.class)
036        ),
037        /** Exporter for line list data, using the ImmutableLineListCSV format. */
038        LINELIST(
039                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableLineListDuckDB.class)
040        ),
041        /**
042         * Exporter for historical test data, using the ImmutableOutbreakHistoryCSV
043         * format.
044         */
045        HISTORICAL_TESTS(
046                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableOutbreakHistoryCSV.class)
047        ),
048        /**
049         * Exporter for contact network data, using the ImmutableContactCSV format.
050         */
051        CONTACT_NETWORK(
052                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableContactDuckDB.class)
053        ),
054        /**
055         * Exporter for infectivity profile data, using the
056         * ImmutableInfectivityProfileCSV format.
057         */
058        INFECTIVITY_PROFILE(
059                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableInfectivityProfileCSV.class)
060        ),
061        /**
062         * Exporter for in host viral load profile data, using the
063         * ImmutableInHostModelCSV format.
064         */
065        VIRAL_CHALLENGE(
066                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableViralChallengeCSV.class)
067        ),
068
069        /**
070         * Exporter for in host viral load profile data, using the
071         * ImmutableInHostModelCSV format.
072         */
073        POST_VACCINATION(
074                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutablePostVaccineCSV.class)
075        ),
076        /**
077         * Exporter for person demographic data, using the
078         * ImmutablePersonDemographicsCSV format.
079         */
080        DEMOGRAPHICS(
081                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutablePersonDemographicsDuckDB.class)
082        ),
083        /**
084         * Exporter for debug parameters, using the ImmutableDebugParametersCSV
085         * format.
086         */
087        DEBUG_PARAMETERS(
088                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableDebugParametersCSV.class)
089        ),
090        /**
091         * Exporter for final state data, using the ImmutableOutbreakFinalStateCSV
092         * format.
093         */
094        FINAL_STATE(
095                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableOutbreakFinalStateCSV.class)
096        ),
097        /**
098         * Exporter for behaviour count data, using the
099         * ImmutableOutbreakBehaviourCountCSV format.
100         */
101        BEHAVIOUR(
102                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableOutbreakBehaviourCountCSV.class)
103        ),
104        /**
105         * Exporter for contact count data, using the
106         * ImmutableOutbreakContactCountCSV format.
107         */
108        CONTACT_COUNTS(
109                        ExportSelector.of(ImmutableOutbreakContactCountCSV.class)
110        );
111
112        private ExportSelector<?> selector;
113
114        Exporters(ExportSelector<?> selector) {
115                this.selector = selector;
116        }
117
118        /**
119         * Get the export selector associated with this exporter.
120         *
121         * @return the ExportSelector instance that defines how to extract and format
122         *         data for this exporter
123         */
124        ExportSelector<?> getSelector() { return this.selector; }
125
126}
